The verb 閉める (to close something) is transitive (tadōshi): for that reason it requires an object marked by を, here 窓 (window). The target focus is precisely the transitive/intransitive pair: 閉める (someone closes something) contrasts with its intransitive pair 閉まる (something closes by itself). ops.issue: 鶏肉 as けいにく is a valid but formal/technical reading; in a spoken shop request (〜をください) the natural everyday reading is とりにく. kana and romaji would need the same update (けいにく→とりにく, keiniku→toriniku).

before.jp: 鶏肉を二百グラムください
before.kana: けいにくをにひゃくぐらむください

structure_explanation.en: Request pattern in a shop: '[item] を [quantity] ください' ('give me [quantity] of [item], please'). 鶏肉 ('chicken') is the object marked by を, 二百グラム ('two hundred grams') is the quantity that stands free before the verb, and ください is the polite way of asking. The quantity takes no particle; it sits right before the verb.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Padrão de pedido em loja: '[item] を [quantidade] ください' ('me dê [quantidade] de [item], por favor'). 鶏肉 ('frango') é o objeto marcado por を, 二百グラム ('duzentos gramas') é a quantidade que vem solta antes do verbo, e ください é a forma de pedir educadamente. A quantidade não leva partícula, fica logo antes do verbo.

ops.issue: この glossed as 'this, that' — この means only 'this' (proximal); 'that' corresponds to その/あの. The 'that' teaches a wrong sense.

before.jp: この空港はとても国際的です
before.kana: このくうこうわとてもこくさいてきです

structure_explanation.en: Basic topic + predicate structure: 'この空港は' (this airport) is the topic marked by は, and the predicate is '国際的です'. 国際的 is a な-adjective (the quality of 'international') that, in the polite form, links directly to です. The adverb とても (very) intensifies the adjective. The focus is the vocabulary 国際的.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Estrutura básica de tópico + predicado: 'この空港は' (este aeroporto) é o tópico marcado por は, e o predicado é '国際的です'. 国際的 é um な-adjetivo (qualidade de 'internacional') que, na forma polida, se liga diretamente a です. O advérbio とても (muito) intensifica o adjetivo. O foco é o vocabulário 国際的.
